title: 第10章 战力排行榜
content_zh:
第10章 战力排行榜
不止是黄强民，有点听出味来的严革和王钟也跟着进到了法医办公室里来。
江远的桌子侧对着门口，几个人拐了一个方向，就能看到江远屏幕上的指纹图像。两团细密的黑白色线条，一团在左，一团在右，像是两团打乱的毛线团似的，看的人眼花缭绕。
黄强民等三人，默契的挪步到江远的后侧，动作轻盈的像是狸猫似的，没有发出丝毫的声响。
对面的吴军一抬头就注意到了三人的动作，愣了愣神，就闷头做自己的事了。与江远这种入门级新警相比，在场的老资格民警，都属于道行不浅的狐级选手，嗅觉灵敏且相互熟悉，动动屁股就知道对方的肠胃情况。
江远正好带着耳机，听着里面的音乐声，两耳不闻窗外事的比对着指纹。
做指纹是一件极其需要专注力的工作。尤其是做指纹库里的指纹，很少有能一蹴而就的。
按部就班的，以常规模式来标记这些陈年指纹，通常都是做不出来的，因为相同或相似的步骤，负责上传的痕检民警，肯定都是尝试过的。
这就好像一道难题，用教科书里的经典式步骤去做，几乎不可能得出答案来。一定是需要变形的，否则，它就不会被筛选到难题的范畴中去。
但如何变形，采用这种变形模式，是否正确和等价，就非常考验人了。
江远得到的弓型纹鉴定（LV3），还做不到大杀四方的程度，江远自己依旧得不断尝试和练习。
一起命案刚刚结束，法医岗的工作相对轻松，让江远可以安心的玩弄指纹。
在黄强民的视角里，江远的动作，很容易让他想到自家女儿给照片做美颜时的操作。那些黑白色的线条不断的被放大缩小，偶尔还会出现移位的情况，颇为复杂的样子。
黄强民想要求解，不由回头看向老严和小王。
两名痕检民警，看起来比平常更呆更傻的样子，像是两只呆猫一样，就直着眼盯着江远的屏幕看。
黄强民目光一转，就知道是什么情况了。
这就好像猛兽到了猎物身边，令猎物恐惧而全身紧绷；老板到了秘书身边，令秘书恐惧而全身紧绷；老婆到了老公身边，令老公恐惧而全身紧绷；老师到了学生身边，令学生恐惧而全身紧绷——老严和小王同志显然是预见到了某种恐怖情形。
江远的手指又点了两下，确定了一个新的特征点。
严革和王钟不由伸头去看，那表情就像是第一次学“鸡兔同笼”问题的小学生，有点好奇，又有点畏难。
黄强民瞅着他们，莫名的竟然有点心疼。山南省的经济水平一般，宁台县更是个小县城，老严和小王就像是许多县城的刑科队民警一样，虽是科班出身，但学的却是又杂又浅，入职定岗做了痕检以后，也没有得到多少系统化的训练，至多是能参与一些培训班，就磕磕绊绊的跟着前辈们将工作做下来了。

在这样的环境下，有的人依靠自学，也能飞快的成长起来，省内的指纹专家，追溯起来，差不多也是一样的路数。
不过，大部分人还是如老严和小王，没什么学习条件，偶尔有点学习动力，最终只是成长为了一枚警队螺丝钉。
相比之下，江远更显的专注且自信。
黄大队长轻轻的咳嗽了两声，将江远自沉浸中拉了出来。
“你帮隆利县做了一个抢劫案的指纹？”黄队长等江远取下耳机，当即发问。
江远反应了一下，点头称是。
黄大队长不由赞许道：“现在的大学生不得了，有本事，有文化。不过……你匹配的指纹怎么都是隆利县的？”
黄强民拖着长长的音，语气中有明显的提点的成分。
“他们上传的指纹比较多吧，正好下载了他们的。”江远自然不好说，他是从一地的软柿子里，随机挑选了一个距离自己比较近的。
黄强民点头：“帮助兄弟单位也不错，嗯，你这边正在做指纹匹配？”
“对，随便找了一个积案……”
“哪个地方的？”
“呃……还是隆利县的。”江远还是很懂得看人眼色的。毕竟是做法医的，死人的脸要看，活人的脸也是要注意的。
黄强民更是没遮掩的意思，他现在就怀疑江远跟隆利县有什么不清不楚的关系，于是直接了当的问出来：“你家里有隆利县的？”
“没。”
“那……算了，你做一个咱们宁台县的指纹看看。”黄强民作风硬朗，直接提出要求。
“好。”江远乖巧的应了，又看黄强民似乎想观看的样子，道：“做指纹对比，时间估计比较久的，不是一时半会能做出来的。案件类型有要求吗？”
“优先积案吧。好好做，出了结果，你直接通知我！”黄强民不是太确定江远的能力，但在宁台县这种地方，八块腹肌的男人好找，懂技术的法医还是很稀罕的。
专门给江远留了电话，黄强民又向吴军点点头，道：“你给他讲一下咱们的战力排行榜。”
接着，黄强民也不管严革和王钟，就直接出了房间。

江远满脸好奇的看向吴军：“战力排行榜？”
这个名字，听着就带点中二气息。
吴军笑了笑，道：“咱们山南省的省厅做的绩效考核榜，就叫这个名字。省内以各个地级市为单位排名，市里以各个县区为单位排名，县里也给各乡镇做排名，考核内容都是一样的，很详细，你把你的警讯通
江远听的愣愣神，哑然道：“KPI没有‘战力排行榜’时髦。真叫这个名字？”
“恩。”吴军重重的点了点头，接着道：“战力排行榜，现在可是咱们的指挥棒，做的好，领导升迁，集体授奖。做的不好，领导就要在全体会议上做检讨，做保证，还做不到的，调任撤职的都有。而且是层层加码，每级都有每级的要求。”
不同于其它政府部门，公安系统的绩效考核机制向来繁复。除了山南省，其他省份和地州，也都有类似的排行榜，只是名字可能有所不同，比如珠海就有警力资源战力榜等等。（注）
清河的战力排行榜极为详细，30多个警种部门的基础业务，600多个子项，全部被赋予了了系数不同的分值，实时更新，同时进行PK。仅仅是刑事案件一块，就有从命案到侵财等多个条目。
吴军大致的做了个介绍，又道：“在县刑警大队的层面，一年的总分1000分左右，侦破一起抢劫积案，或者其他七大类的积案，都能有30分左右，系列案还会有加成。命案的分数最高，侦破一起积案并抓到人，能有70分到100分。侵财类的案件，比如盗窃这种，侦破一起案件大概0.1到0.5分，系列案或者抓到人，能增加一点……”
“你刚才说的命案和抢劫案都是积案，现案呢？”江远听的不由问了一句。
“八大重案的现案，都是倒扣机制。”吴军顿了一下，郑重的道：“这个非常恐怖的。你比如命案的现案是100分，出现一起命案，侦破并且抓到人了，那就是100分全得，出现两起或者三起，侦破了抓到人，还是这100分。但如果出现了两起，有一起没侦破，那就直接扣掉70分，两起没侦破就扣140，三起210分，以此类推……”
“那要是有10个破不了的命案，岂不是要扣700分。”
“理论上是这样。”
“实际上呢？”
“实际上，市里能忍你五个，县里最多3个命案破不了，刑警大队长就该换人了。”
“那要是成功侦破一起命案积案，岂不是能得整个刑警大队十分之一的分数？”江远听的诧异。
吴法医“呵”的笑了起来：“甭谦虚，能顶五分之一，还能立功受奖。咱们队去年也就七百多分的样子，里面还有好些基础分。你知道咱队上次破获的命案积案是什么时候的事？两年以前了。而且，指纹固然重要，但也有它的局限性，不是每个案件都有重要的指纹线索的，有也不一定能比中。就是其他重案，能比中一个，你就是生产队最大的驴，能先挑母驴的那种。”
“怪不得……”江远这下子有点明白大队长的心情了，他等于给隆利县赚了三四十分。
吴军宽解道：“帮别的单位破案也有积分拿，这个属于合作。起到关键作用的话，能拿积分的四分之一，五分之一……总之，能破案就是好事，但给自家破又比给隔壁破舒服。”
四分之一也比自己破案少很多，但可以卷其他的县。
江远有点回过味来，怪不得大队长要师父给自己介绍这个战力排行榜，只是，接下来，他又不知道该怎么选案子了。

王钟这时候清了清嗓子，道：“我知道一个案子……”
注1：确实有省份制作了“战力排行榜”，名字一字不差，功能类书所述，略有改动。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 10 Combat Power Ranking
Not only Huang Qiangmin, but also Yan Ge and Wang Zhong, who had noticed the smell, also followed him into the medical examiner's office.
Jiang Yuan's desk faced the door. When several people turned in one direction, they could see the fingerprint image on Jiang Yuan's screen. There are two groups of fine black and white lines, one on the left and one on the right, like two messed up balls of wool, which dazzles the viewer.
Huang Qiangmin and the other three people moved to the back of Jiang Yuan in tacit agreement, moving as lightly as a civet cat without making the slightest sound.
Wu Jun on the opposite side noticed the movements of the three people as soon as he raised his head. He was stunned and then went about his own business. Compared with entry-level new police officers like Jiang Yuan, the veteran police officers present were all fox-level players with a good sense of smell and familiarity with each other. They could know each other's gastrointestinal condition by moving their buttocks.
Jiang Yuan happened to be wearing headphones, listening to the music inside, and comparing his fingerprints while ignoring what was happening outside the window.
Doing fingerprints is a task that requires a lot of concentration. Especially when creating fingerprints in a fingerprint database, it is rarely possible to do so overnight.
It is usually impossible to mark these old fingerprints step by step and in the conventional mode, because the trace inspection police responsible for uploading must have tried the same or similar steps.
This is like a difficult problem. It is almost impossible to get the answer using the classic steps in the textbook. It must need to be deformed, otherwise, it will not be filtered into the category of difficult problems.
But how to deform and whether this deformation mode is correct and equivalent is very challenging.
The bow pattern identification (LV3) obtained by Jiang Yuan is not enough to kill everyone. Jiang Yuan still has to keep trying and practicing.
A murder case had just ended, and the work at the forensic post was relatively easy, allowing Jiang Yuan to play with fingerprints with peace of mind.
From Huang Qiangmin's perspective, Jiang Yuan's movements easily reminded him of his daughter's beautification operations for photos. Those black and white lines are constantly being enlarged and reduced, and occasionally shifted, making it quite complicated.
Huang Qiangmin wanted to ask for explanation, but couldn't help but look back at Lao Yan and Xiao Wang.
The two trace inspection policemen looked even more stupid than usual, like two stupid cats, staring straight at Jiang Yuan's screen.
Huang Qiangmin turned his eyes and knew what was going on.
It's like a beast comes to its prey, making the prey tense up in fear; when the boss comes to the secretary, the secretary becomes scared and tense up; when a wife comes to her husband, the husband becomes scared and tense up; when a teacher comes over to a student, the student becomes scared and tense up - Lao Yan and Comrade Xiao Wang obviously foresee some kind of terrifying situation.
Jiang Yuan clicked his fingers twice more and determined a new feature point.
Yan Ge and Wang Zhong couldn't help but stretch their heads to take a look. Their expressions were like those of primary school students learning the "chicken and rabbit in the same cage" problem for the first time. They were a little curious and a little afraid.
Huang Qiangmin looked at them, feeling a little distressed for no reason. The economic level of Shannan Province is average, and Ningtai County is even a small county. Lao Yan and Xiao Wang are like the policemen of the Criminal Division of many counties. Although they are from professional backgrounds, their studies are complicated and superficial. After joining the job and undergoing trace inspection, they did not receive much systematic training. At most, they were able to participate in some training classes, and they followed their seniors to complete the work.
In such an environment, some people can grow up quickly by relying on self-study. Looking back, the fingerprint experts in the province have almost followed the same path.
However, most people, like Lao Yan and Xiao Wang, have little learning conditions and occasionally have some motivation to learn. In the end, they just grow into cogs in the police force.
In contrast, Jiang Yuan was more focused and confident.
Captain Huang coughed twice, pulling Jiang Yuan out of his immersion.
“You did fingerprints for a robbery in Longley County?Captain Huang waited for Jiang Yuan to take off his headphones and asked immediately.
Jiang Yuan reacted and nodded in agreement.
Captain Huang couldn't help but praise: "Today's college students are amazing, capable and educated. But...how come the fingerprints you matched are all from Longli County? "
Huang Qiangmin drawled a long note, and there was an obvious hint in his tone.
"They uploaded more fingerprints, so I just downloaded theirs. "Jiang Yuan naturally couldn't tell. He randomly selected one that was relatively close to him from among the weak persimmons in the area.
Huang Qiangmin nodded: "It's not bad to help our brothers. Well, are you doing fingerprint matching here? "
"Yes, I just found a backlog of cases..."
"Which place? "
“Uh…it’s still from Longli County. "Jiang Yuan still knows how to read people's looks. After all, he is a forensic doctor. He has to look at the faces of dead people and pay attention to the faces of living people.
Huang Qiangmin didn't mean to hide it. He now suspected that Jiang Yuan had some unclear relationship with Longli County, so he asked directly: "Do you have a family member from Longli County? "
"without. "
"Then... forget it, take a fingerprint of our Ningtai County and see. "Huang Qiangmin has a tough style and makes demands directly.
"Okay. Jiang Yuan responded obediently, and looking at Huang Qiangmin who seemed to want to watch, he said: "Fingerprint comparison will probably take a long time, and it cannot be done in a short time." Are there any requirements for case type? "
“Let’s prioritize the backlog. Do it well and let me know the results directly! "Huang Qiangmin is not too sure about Jiang Yuan's ability, but in a place like Ningtai County, men with eight-pack abs are easy to find, and forensic doctors who understand technology are still very rare.
After leaving a special phone number for Jiang Yuan, Huang Qiangmin nodded to Wu Jun and said, "Tell him our combat power rankings. "
Then, Huang Qiangmin ignored Yan Ge and Wang Zhong and left the room directly.
Jiang Yuan looked at Wu Jun with curiosity: "Combat power ranking? "
This name sounds a little bit chubby.
Wu Jun smiled and said: "The performance appraisal list made by our Shannan Provincial Department is called this name. The province is ranked by each prefecture-level city, the city is ranked by each county, and the county also ranks each township. The assessment content is the same and very detailed.
Jiang Yuan was stunned when he heard this, and said dumbly: "KPI is not as fashionable as the 'combat power ranking'. Is it really called that?"
"Yes." Wu Jun nodded heavily and continued: "The combat power rankings are now our baton. If you do well, the leader will be promoted and awarded collectively. If you do not do well, the leader will review and make guarantees at the plenary meeting. If you can't do it, there will be transfers and removals. And it is added layer by layer, and each level has requirements for each level."
Unlike other government departments, the performance appraisal mechanism of the public security system has always been complicated. In addition to Shannan Province, other provinces and prefectures also have similar rankings, but the names may be different. For example, Zhuhai has a ranking list of police resources and so on. (Note)
Qinghe's combat power rankings are extremely detailed. The basic business of more than 30 police departments and more than 600 sub-items are all given scores with different coefficients, updated in real time, and PK is conducted at the same time. Just for criminal cases, there are many items ranging from homicide to property embezzlement.
Wu Jun gave a general introduction and then said: "At the county criminal police brigade level, the total score in a year is about 1,000 points. If you solve a robbery case or other seven major categories of backlog cases, you can get about 30 points, and there will be bonuses for series of cases. Life. The score of a case is the highest. If you solve a backlog of cases and arrest someone, you can get 70 to 100 points. For a case of property infringement, such as theft, you can get 0.1 to 0.5 points if you solve a case. A series of cases or if you arrest someone, you can get a little more..."
"The murders and robberies you just mentioned are backlog cases. What about the current cases?" Jiang Yuantingcouldn't help but ask.
"The current cases of the eight major serious crimes are all undercutting mechanisms." Wu Jun paused and said solemnly: "This is very scary. For example, if the current murder case is 100 points, if a murder case occurs, the person is detected and the person is arrested, then it will be 100 points. Yes, if there are two or three cases and the person is detected and arrested, the same 100 points will be given. But if there are two cases and one of them is not solved, then 70 points will be deducted directly. If two cases are not solved, 140 points will be deducted. If there are three cases, 210 points will be deducted, and so on..."
"Then if there are 10 unsolved murders, wouldn't it mean that 700 points would be deducted?"
"That's the theory."
"Actually?"
"Actually, the city can tolerate five of you, but the county can't solve at most three murder cases. It's time for the criminal police captain to be replaced."
"Then if you successfully solve a backlog of murder cases, wouldn't you get one-tenth of the score of the entire criminal police team?" Jiang Yuan was surprised when he heard this.
Forensic Doctor Wu laughed: "Don't be humble. You can score one-fifth of the points, and you can also receive awards for your meritorious service. Our team only scored more than 700 points last year, and there are still many basic points in it. Do you know when was the last time our team solved the backlog of murder cases? Two years ago. Yes. Fingerprints are important, but they also have their limitations. Not every case has important fingerprint clues, and if they do, they may not be able to match other serious cases. If you can match one, you will be the biggest donkey in the production team and the one who can pick the female donkey first."
"No wonder..." Jiang Yuan now understood the captain's mood. He had earned thirty or forty points for Longli County.
Wu Junkuan explained: "You can also get points for helping other units solve crimes. This is cooperation. If you play a key role, you can get one-quarter or one-fifth of the points... In short, it is a good thing to solve the case, but it is more comfortable to solve the case for yourself than for the next door."
A quarter is much less than solving crimes on your own, but you can solve cases in other counties.
Jiang Yuan came back to his senses. No wonder the captain asked his master to introduce him to this combat power ranking list. However, next, he didn't know how to choose a case.
Wang Zhong cleared his throat at this time and said: "I know a case..."
Note 1: There is indeed a province that has produced a "Combat Power Ranking", the name is word for word, and the function book has slight changes.
(End of chapter)
